serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: A cloud-based AI inference platform that provides managed model deployment, autoscaling, and serving infrastructure for production machine learning workloads.

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: Repository for FedRAMP certification materials, SOC 2 Type II report, security policies, and supporting compliance evidence.
trustCenter.accessRequestInstructions: Agency personnel may request access through the access-request form on the Baseten trust center.

secureConfigurationGuidance.repositoryDescription: Secure deployment and configuration requirements for customers using the Baseten Inference Platform.

certifiedServices.serviceDescription: Reserved, autoscaling GPU/CPU compute for customer-owned and custom-trained models, deployed through Baseten's Truss framework. Customers get dedicated hardware, full deployment-lifecycle management, and multi-cloud capacity, suited for steady, latency-sensitive, or high-scale production inference workloads that need consistent performance and reliability.

Fully managed, serverless inference endpoints for popular open-source and frontier models, compatible with the OpenAI Chat Completions and Anthropic Messages API formats. Billed per token with no dedicated infrastructure required from the customer, Model APIs are optimized and hosted by Baseten and are suited for variable-traffic workloads and rapid prototyping through production.

certified.useCase: Amazon Web Services (AWS US East/West) is the underlying public cloud infrastructure provider (compute, storage, networking, GPU capacity) hosting the Baseten Inference Platform within the assessment boundary.

approvedAlternativeSecurityFramework.note: Baseten's active SOC 2 Type II (Security) report is designated as the qualifying FRC-CLA-ASF Approved Alternative Security Framework for this Class A Certification. Per FRC-CLA-EAM, the complete SOC 2 Type II report, any applicable bridge or gap letter, verified audit engagement documentation, and the estimated schedule for the upcoming report should be supplied to all necessary parties alongside this package.
approvedAlternativeSecurityFramework.schemaNote: FRC-CLA-ASF requires providers to identify their Approved Alternative Security Framework. The published Overview schema defines no property for it, so it is carried here as a declared object.

packageMetadata.programStatus: No FedRAMP ID has been assigned and no submission has been made to FedRAMP or any agency. This offering has an active FedRAMP Marketplace listing (Package ID FR2632558748; Phase: Initial Implementation; Status: Not yet certified). The Security Decision Record covers all 40 FedRAMP rules applicable to Class A (mandatory, recommended, and relevant optional) per the FedRAMP 20x Class A Ruleset Reference, and includes sample Initial/Ongoing Incident Report artifacts plus a Final Incident Report template. The Security Decision Record and Ongoing Certification Report conform to the published FedRAMP JSON schemas, confirmed by structural validation against each schema's required fields, types, and enums. As of 2026-10-21: 31 of 40 items are Implemented, 3 are Partially Implemented, and 6 are Not Implemented (predominantly optional practices Baseten has deliberately not adopted). Baseten's SOC 2 Type II report is the designated FRC-CLA-ASF Approved Alternative Security Framework, serving as the independent assessment source wherever its scope covers an item. One open item remains outside the rule set itself: the Marketplace listing shows Class 'Unknown', which Baseten is reconciling with FedRAMP against this package's documented Class A path.
